giza.definition: n. an ancient Egyptian city on the west bank of the Nile opposite Cairo; site of three Great Pyramids and the Sphinx
giza.translation: n. 吉萨（地名）；吉萨棉；吉萨金字塔

gizmo.definition:
n something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known
n a device or control that is very useful for a particular job
gizmo.translation: n. 小发明, 小玩意儿

gizmos.definition:
plural of gizmo
n something unspecified whose name is either forgotten or not known
n a device or control that is very useful for a particular job
gizmos.translation: (gizmo 的复数) n. 小发明, 小玩意儿

gizzard.definition: n. thick-walled muscular pouch below the crop in many birds and reptiles for grinding food
gizzard.translation:
n. (鸟的)砂囊, 胃
[医] 砂囊

gizzards.definition: n. thick-walled muscular pouch below the crop in many birds and reptiles for grinding food
gizzards.translation: n. （鸟的）砂囊( gizzard的复数形式 ); （鸟的）胃; <俗>喉咙; （人的）胃

gizzy.translation: n. 大麻(毒品相关用语)
